checks.note: Both inputs are V2. The previous compatibility overlay is deliberately excluded and no V1 reader remains in this script.

catalog.intentionalRemoval: The prior overlay added 120 normalized definitions, including two provider identities absent from the V2 source. Those aliases are removed by explicit requirement; counts now come only from the V2 source and its declared modes.
catalog.countsAre: Catalog definitions and enabled candidates, not credential-verified provider availability.

negativeControl.mutation: Temporarily removed only ProviderRecord.check, which rejects a provider-level npm declaration. This would otherwise admit an empty V1 provider through the extensible provider record.
negativeControl.command: bun test test/models.test.ts --test-name-pattern 'rejects V1 and mixed'

behaviorCovered: V1 and mixed documents are rejected, including a V1 provider with no models; actual V2 capability/API/pricing declarations remain accepted.
A fresh V1 cache is removed and replaced by the bundled V2 read, even when network fetching is disabled.
V1 HTTP responses are not cached and cannot cause an automatic public V1 fallback. A good V2 cache survives incompatible refresh responses.
An explicitly configured invalid file surfaces its decoding failure instead of silently returning the bundled catalog.
The sole public source and the official models.dev root resolve to V2; configured mirrors retain priority but must pass the same V2 schema.
Model.Catalog and the generated public Client accept only format 2. Every normalized bundled model passes the public Model.Info round trip.
Removed the V1 source schemas, normalization, cost and reasoning conversion helpers, compatibility text/manifest, fallback endpoints and format-dependent Session pricing branches.
Converted the active reasoning/provider catalog fixtures to V2 and retained their existing variant, URL-template and shared-state ownership regressions.
Pending Changesets and current product/adoption guides describe exclusive V2 support; earlier validation records remain historical evidence.
limits: This requirement applies to model catalog format. Other domains with independently versioned protocols or historical accounting are outside this change; recorded spending was not repriced or deleted.
No live inference, provider login, paid calls, installed-service restart, deployed validation, remote CI, push or publication.
Only the listed focused suites ran, not all repository tests. Core metering integration uses loopback HTTP/SSE fixture responses.
Unobserved billing quantities, cache storage attribution, native-tool completeness and the remaining upstream feature inventory are unchanged.
